text_en:
Instruments | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The testing procedure for all types of energy meters for 500kv, 132kv units and lines
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ahmad Mohamed Hamada, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Diaa El-Gabalawe, revised by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC general director quality control, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zaid Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station,
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Maintenance staff should be trained well, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... etc
The Unit or Line meters under test must be out of service.
A work permit must be issued and maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Maintenance staff should be trained well, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... etc
The Unit or Line meters under test must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multimeter
Meter test PTS 1.3
Test stand
Digital multimeter
Meter test PTS 1.3
Test stand
Work to be Done
Preparation
Review the technical reference material and the manufacturer's manual.
Obtain a copy of the attached test certificate
Short-circuit the current transformers and open-circuit the voltage transformers feeding the meter.
Be sure there is no voltage at meter terminals using multimeter.
Disconnect the meter wires and insulate them with adhesive tape.
Remove the meter from the panel and take it to the lab.
Review the technical reference material and the manufacturer's manual.
Obtain a copy of the attached test certificate
Short-circuit the current transformers and open-circuit the voltage transformers feeding the meter.
Be sure there is no voltage at meter terminals using multimeter.
Disconnect the meter wires and insulate them with adhesive tape.
Remove the meter from the panel and take it to the lab.
Testing Procedures
Put the meter at test stand.
Measure the meter insulation at 100v.
Connect the meter terminals to the meter test PTS1.3 as shown at figure 1
Connect the scanning head between the meter and meter test.
Switch power on to the meter test.
Adjust meter test to measurement function and select "error measure' mode.
From the sub-menu:
Select 4 wire measurement.
Select watt measurement.
Enter meter constant.
Enter number of pulses
Select 4 wire measurement.
Select watt measurement.
Enter meter constant.
Enter number of pulses
Adjust the voltage at 100v.
Inject the current and adjust the scanning head.
Adjust pf =1.0
Adjust the current at 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100% of load current.
Measure the error.
Record the readings at the attached test certificate
Adjust pf = 0.5
Repeat steps 11, 12, 13.
Make sure the error is within the acceptable limits.
Return the Meter to Service
Switch power off.
Disconnect the meter terminals from the meter test set.
Measure the meter insulation at 1000v.
Return the meter to the panel at site.
Connect meter wires.
Disconnect the SC and close the voltage circuits.
Place a copy of test results in the field maintenance file.
